events.title: SpaceX (SPCX) Q3 2026 results & earnings webcast

events.title: SpaceX (SPCX) Super Intelligence AI compute, capex and financing disclosures
events.sourceLabel: SpaceX investor relations and SEC filings
events.basis: SpaceX October 26 SEC Form 8-K confirms an October 24 binding commitment letter for an approximately $40bn Apollo-managed GPU finance lease, not a closed $40bn cash-funded purchase. It expects signing/closing before year-end 2026 subject to conditions and delivery/lease schedules in H1 2027. No future exact day published. Monitor SI revenue, capex cash conversion, lease execution, NVIDIA Vera Rubin delivery and follow-up 8-Ks.
events.importance: Track lease closing/delivery and funding needs, Vera Rubin GPU and AI-networking demand, SI infrastructure utilization and returns.

events.title: SpaceX (SPCX) $40bn GPU finance-lease commitment disclosed
events.basis: SpaceX disclosed on October 26 a binding commitment letter dated October 24 to enter a roughly $40bn master finance lease with an Apollo-managed entity for NVIDIA Vera Rubin GPU pods and related equipment. The master lease is NOT yet closed; subject to conditions, closing expected before year-end 2026 and delivery/lease schedules anticipated in H1 2027. No exact closing/delivery date confirmed. October 26 is disclosure date, not lease closing.
events.importance: Major financing and GPU demand catalyst: Vera Rubin equipment, Super Intelligence data-center capex, financing costs and liquidity; NVIDIA supply read-through.

events.title: Samsung next shareholder-return policy · late Jan 2027 board watch
events.basis: Samsung said at its October 29 Q3 results that its next shareholder-return policy, the final 2026 return amount and execution details are expected to be finalized at a board meeting scheduled for late January 2027, with an announcement afterward. It did not publish an exact board or announcement date; do not assign one. Total 2026 returns are estimated at KRW90–110tn, of which KRW35tn has been planned or completed and KRW55–75tn remains.
events.importance: Buyback cancellation versus cash dividend mix and timing; preferred/common share spread; potential buy-side shareholder-return catalyst.

These product launch periods are management expectations, NOT confirmed calendar days.
